title: Gram determinant bound det(v_i·v_j) ≤ exp(Σ|v_a|² − n)
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ and all vectors v_1, …, v_n ∈ ℝ^P, the Gram determinant satisfies det(v_i·v_j)_{i,j=1}^n ≤ exp(Σ_{a=1}^n |v_a|² − n). (For n = 0 the determinant of the empty matrix is 1 and the right-hand side is exp(0) = 1.)
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → Euclid P), Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (v i) (v j)) ≤ Real.exp (∑ a, ‖v a‖ ^ 2 - (n : ℝ))
